title: Vol structures
dek: Inner vol book: five standing Brent options trades. For each one: what happens if Brent moves $1, what time passing does, what fear does, and the most it can lose.

claims.text: At the October 23, 2026 ICE Brent settlements (January 2027 expiry, futures 111.70), the five standing vol structures mark: own the tail premium paid 2.41 per barrel, call spread paid 2.07, fade the wing collected 0.32, risk reversal collected 0.09, covered call collected 3.08. The covered call collects $105 per lot per day in rent (theta) at those marks.

What a $1 Brent rise does at the same marks, per 1,000-barrel lot: covered call gains about $746, tail call gains about $206, risk reversal gains about $506. If fear jumps one point, the tail call gains about $97.
